metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Discovery Protocol (v1.2)
metadata.description: Enhanced discovery protocol enabling autonomous and distributed AI agents to locate, interpret, cache, probe, and initialize FFT AI Edition modules, substrates, and capabilities.

discovery_profile.notes: v1.2 adds multi-agent discovery, distributed resolution, substrate probing, harmonic escalation detection, and runtime/autonomy alignment.

discovery_sequence.name: Locate Manifest
discovery_sequence.description: Agent identifies the canonical manifest to understand directory structure.

discovery_sequence.name: Load Registry
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads the module registry to enumerate available FFT modules.
actions: Distribute registry snapshot to peer agents

discovery_sequence.name: Initialize Core
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads the minimal FFT core to establish baseline conceptual primitives.
actions: Verify core integrity across distributed agents

discovery_sequence.name: Load Full Specification
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads the full FFT specification to access structures, types, and validation profiles.
actions: Probe spec for harmonic escalation support

discovery_sequence.name: Load Execution Graph
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads the conceptual execution graph for routing and reasoning.

discovery_sequence.name: Load Runtime
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads runtime configuration for execution.

discovery_sequence.name: Load Autonomy Profile
discovery_sequence.description: Agent loads autonomy tiers and behavioral constraints.
actions: Align autonomy with runtime and execution graph

discovery_sequence.name: Bind Hardware Profile
discovery_sequence.description: Agent binds hardware capability profile to substrate and spec.

multi_agent_discovery.notes: Allows multiple agents to coordinate FFT discovery and maintain conceptual consistency.

substrate_probing.notes: Agents probe substrate for available kernels and adjust routing accordingly.

discovery_events.description: Triggered when an FFT module is successfully loaded.
Triggered when harmonic paradox mode is detected during discovery.

compatibility.notes: v1.2 discovery requires execution graph, runtime, and autonomy layers for full agent readiness.
